purpose: Provide crafted alternative item IDs for native in-game item tooltips. The comparison remains a same-slot research example, not a claim of equivalent stats.

Gemmed Copper Gauntlets.note: The crafted gloves may have a random enchantment. Output item ID is 3474; Plans item ID 3610 is different.

Mithril Claws.note: Forever-only crafted fist weapon. 250609 is the output; Plans: Mithril Claws is a different item, 251461.

Mithril Plate Pants.note: Forever entry is Mail legs despite the Plate word in its name; older Classic version was Mithril Scale Pants.

Steel Breastplate.note: This Forever item is Mail chest gear; it is not a plate chest piece.

integration: Copy BlacksmithingComparisons.lua over the local addon file. Existing Comparisons.lua reads matches[].outputItemID. JSON is for editing/research only.
warnings: No GitHub edits were made for this Blacksmithing task.
Native tooltip appearance still requires a /reload test in the actual WoW Forever beta client.
Research uses item output IDs, not Plans scroll IDs.
Same-slot comparisons remain same-slot, with original research notes preserved.
